newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL Q1 net income seen at 13bln forints.
newsitem.headline: MOL Q1 net income seen at 13bln forints.

text.p: Hungary's largest capitalised issue, oil and gas company MOL, will see IAS net income of 13 billion forints in the first quarter of 1997, according to a Reuters poll of six analysts and traders.
In 1996 MOL generated an IAS consolidated net income of 22.2 billion forints for the whole year, but did not break out this figure on a quarterly basis.
MOL will release its first quarter earnings reports on Tuesday.
In the first quarter of 1996 MOL had a group HAS after-tax profit of 8.16 billion forints and an unconsolidated IAS profit of 8.42 billion forints.
